itemBehavior.label: Behaviors
itemBehavior.description: How the item places its block or furniture, and what else it does (range mining, composting …)

behavior.label: Placement Behavior
behavior.description: How the item places its block or furniture: on any face, only on the ground, walls or ceilings, on liquids, or over several blocks. For an item that places nothing of its own, name the block or furniture it places.
behavior.hint: For an item with its own block or furniture, the export fills in its ID and keeps only a placement that fits it. Placement rules per furniture variant (rotation, alignment) are set in the Furniture section of the model tab.

type.label: type
type.help: The block placements (…block_item) fit a block, the furniture placements (…furniture_item) fit furniture.

block.label: block
block.help: Only for an item without a block of its own; for the item's own block the export fills in its ID.

furniture.label: furniture
furniture.help: Only for an item without furniture of its own; for the item's own furniture the export fills in its ID.

yOffset.label: y_offset
yOffset.help: How many blocks above the liquid surface the block is placed (default 1). The plugin reads y_offset; the wiki's offset_y is ignored.

againstBlocks.label: against_blocks
againstBlocks.help: Block IDs or states such as minecraft:oak_fence[east=true].

blacklist.label: blacklist
blacklist.help: On (default): the furniture cannot be placed against these blocks. Off: only against these blocks.

behaviors.label: Extra Behaviors
behaviors.description: Behaviors the item has besides placing: mining an area, composting, lighting fires. The export lists them after the placement.

rangeMiningItem.label: range_mining_item
rangeMiningItem.help: Breaks more blocks around the mined one; the range turns with the direction the player faces.

range.label: range
range.help: Offsets width,height,depth from the mined block, one per entry.

compostableItem.label: compostable_item
compostableItem.help: Makes an item compostable that is not compostable in vanilla. Hoppers ignore it.

chance.label: chance
chance.help: Chance that the composter level rises (0–1, default 0.55).

flintAndSteelItem.label: flint_and_steel_item
flintAndSteelItem.help: Lights fires like flint and steel. Registered in CraftEngine 26.9, not documented on the wiki.
